what: Countries offered when signing up in the Bleap app: after choosing an email account (e.g. Google), you pick a country and need a phone number from it. This is the app's sign-up list, not Bleap's card eligibility rule.
notUsedYet: Not on the site. Bleap's help center still says cards are only issued to residents of the EEA or Switzerland, and it refuses US, UAE and 43 other nationalities, so this list can't be read as 'card available'. Compare with data/cards.json (bleap) before using it.
